title: Postcards — Angles
description: post-cards/data/theme/angles.json. degrees are candidate ghost-stack card-tilt angles; one is picked per postcard by its seeded RNG. letterDegrees is a separate, finer-grained candidate list for the letter's own tilt, indexed directly by date-hash modulo its length (HashUtils.pickByModulo) rather than the RNG — its order is deliberately shuffled (not sorted) so that modulo picking doesn't cluster nearby dates on nearby angles.
